title: MiJu's Pale Garden
description: My take on the pale garden biome that aims to change the Textures while keeping most of the original vibe
body:
**My take on the pale garden biome that aims to change the Textures while keeping most of the original vibe**

## Features:
- creaking
- creaking heart
- pale moss
- pale leaves
- pale logs

supports glowing creaking eyes with mods like **Optifine** or **Entity Texture Features**
